name: zaemit
description: Build and run your Zaemit website by chatting: pages, boards, inquiry forms, shop, reservations, contests and events.

interface.shortDescription: 말만 하면 기획부터 제작, 운영까지 해주는 AI 웹빌더
interface.longDescription:
재밋(Zaemit)은 말만 하면 기획부터 제작, 운영까지 해 주는 AI 웹빌더입니다. 만들고 싶은 사이트를 문장으로 설명하면 AI가 기획과 제작을 진행하고, 완성된 뒤에도 데이터 관리와 일상 운영까지 하나의 흐름으로 이어집니다. ChatGPT에 연결하면 이 모든 것을 대화로 합니다.

사이트 만들기는 한 문장에서 시작합니다. ChatGPT에게 "성수동에 있는 우리 공방 홈페이지 만들어줘. 따뜻하고 차분하게, 클래스 소개·오시는 길·문의 폼 넣어서"라고 말해 보세요. 재밋이 페이지를 디자인하고 문구를 쓰고 사진을 채우고 헤더·푸터·메뉴까지 갖춥니다. 사이트는 바로 고유 주소로 공개되고, AI 검색 최적화(AEO/GEO)가 기본으로 들어갑니다.

만들기는 시작일 뿐입니다. ChatGPT와 계속 대화하며 사이트를 운영하세요. "게시판 넣어줘", "예약 받게 해줘" 한마디면 데이터와 관리 화면까지 갖춘 기능이 사이트에 준비됩니다. ChatGPT와의 대화로 아래 모든 기능을 이용할 수 있습니다.
- 페이지 수정(제목·섹션·배경·페이지 이름·메뉴, 모든 변경 되돌리기)
- 문의 폼(폼·항목 추가, 들어온 문의 확인·답변·진행 상태)
- 게시판(공지 게시판 열기, 글 쓰기·고치기·지우기, 원하는 페이지에 배치)
- 예약(예약 상품·일정, 새 예약 확인·확정)
- 쇼핑몰(상품·분류, 가격·진열, 주문 상태, 후기 답글, 쿠폰)
- 공모전·행사(공모전 열고 접수작 심사 단계, 참가자·체크인·등록·세션 프로그램)
- 홍보·통계(SEO, 팝업, 방문 통계)
defaultPrompt: 성수동 카페 홈페이지 만들어줘. 메뉴, 오시는 길, 문의 양식을 넣어줘.
아메리카노를 3,000원 상품으로 등록하고 홈페이지에 상품 목록을 보여줘.

positive.description: Build a new site: a cafe owner connected an empty new site and asks for a homepage.
positive.prompt: Make a website for my cafe "Haru" in Seongsu with a menu introduction, directions and a contact form.
positive.tools_triggered: site_map, design_blocks, design_block, page_compose, inquiry_addFields, menu_create
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT may first propose a design direction or ask for missing details. After the user agrees, the home page is built with designed sections for the menu, directions and a contact form, and the reply gives the public URL. Details the user did not give (prices, address, opening hours) are shown as examples or "coming soon", not presented as facts.

positive.description: Split sections into pages: the owner wants the menu, directions and contact on their own pages.
positive.prompt: Make "Menu", "Directions" and "Contact" separate pages and link them in the menu tree.
positive.expected_behavior: Three pages (Menu, Directions, Contact) exist and each is linked from the site menu. The Contact page keeps the existing contact form. The reply lists the pages.

positive.description: Add a notice board with posts: the owner wants to share news on the home page.
positive.prompt: Create a notice board at the bottom of my home page and post three notices: an opening notice, a grand-opening event and reservation information. Write the content for me.
positive.expected_behavior: A notice board appears at the bottom of the home page with three posts on those topics. The reply lists the posts. If the board feature is not installed yet, ChatGPT installs it first.

positive.description: Add products: a cafe owner adds drinks to the shop and shows them on the home page.
positive.prompt: Add Fruit Smoothie, Cookie Frappe and Peppermint Tea as products with example prices, and show the products on my home page.
positive.expected_behavior: The three products are created with example prices and the product list is shown on the home page. The reply lists the names and prices. If no prices are given, ChatGPT asks for them instead of inventing them.

positive.description: Reservation requests: the cafe owner wants visitors to request a visit and then reviews the requests.
positive.prompt: Add a form to my home page where visitors can request a reservation, then show me the reservation requests that have come in.
positive.expected_behavior: A reservation request form (name, contact, preferred date and time, party size, requests) appears on the home page, and the reply lists the requests received so far with the contact number masked (for example 010-****-1234). On a site that was just built the list is empty; the demo site in Flow A has a sample request. Requests are not confirmed automatically; the reply says the cafe confirms them separately.

negative.description: Bulk deletion: no tool deletes a whole board. Nothing is deleted in this request. ChatGPT says deleting the whole board is not available; it may offer to remove the board from the page and move the posts to the trash, which runs only after the user agrees.
negative.prompt: Delete the notice board you just made, all of it.

negative.description: Refund request: refunds must not be performed through this app. Nothing is refunded or cancelled. ChatGPT says refunds are not available through this app and points to the Zaemit admin. ChatGPT may look up orders first (order_listOrders); the demo site has no orders because online payment is not connected, so it may also say there is no order.
negative.prompt: Issue a full refund for my most recent order.

negative.description: Another site: the connection is bound to one site. The URL below is another site owned by the same test account. Nothing is changed; ChatGPT says the connected site is a different one and that site needs its own connection.
negative.prompt: Change the main page title of https://wv1792976081764023.zaemit.ai to "Today".

publication.release_notes:
Zaemit 1.1
- The app name now shows Zaemit(재밋), so Korean users can find it by searching 재밋.
- The listing (short and long description, starter prompts and keywords) is now written in Korean for our Korean users.
- No change to the tools: the features are the same as in version 1.0.
- Safety is unchanged: one site per connection, deletions first return a confirmation request instead of running, delete tools are marked destructive, masked personal data by default, and no payments, refunds, bulk deletion or member management through the app.
